review.tagline: Visual builder for LLM workflows, RAG pipelines and agents, with APIs
review.summary: Dify is an LLM app development platform with a visual workflow canvas, a prompt IDE, a RAG pipeline that extracts text from PDFs and PPTs, and agents that run in their own sandbox. Every app is exposed through an API. Model providers include GPT, Mistral, Llama3 and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. It runs via Docker Compose or as the hosted Dify Cloud.
review.audience: Teams building and self-hosting LLM apps, RAG and agent workflows
strengths: Visual workflow canvas, prompt IDE and RAG pipeline in one platform
Every app exposes an API, so it works as a backend service
Supports hundreds of LLMs plus any OpenAI API-compatible model
Agents can use Marketplace tools, MCP servers or your own APIs
weaknesses: License is the Dify Open Source License (Apache 2.0 plus extra conditions)
SSO, RBAC and support SLAs are in the Enterprise edition
Docker Compose self-hosting needs at least 2 CPU cores and 4 GiB RAM
Observability relies on external tools such as Opik, Langfuse and Arize Phoenix
needs: Models: GPT, Mistral, Llama3, OpenAI API-compatible models
